content: {"praised":["Atmospheric and haunting tone enhances the thriller experience.","Strong performances, especially Julia Ormond as the ice princess.","Engaging mystery with chills and suspense throughout.","Thoughtful exploration of human emotions and cultural themes.","Visually striking scenes set in Greenland and Denmark."],"criticized":["Pacing too slow, leading to boredom.","Plot feels silly and lacks depth.","Flat character development, especially the female lead.","No chemistry between lead and boyfriend.","Little boy character underutilized."]}
